name: degoog-extensions
description: Extensions for degoog search by EthanC.
author: EthanC

plugins.name: Timestamp
plugins.description: Converts Unix timestamps into human readable UTC and local dates, and dates back into timestamps. Triggers on bare timestamps, ISO dates and keywords such as epoch or unix time.

plugins.name: Time zone
plugins.description: Current time anywhere, time zone conversions and daylight saving dates, from plain questions such as “time in tokyo”, “5pm ET to PT” or “when do the clocks change”.

plugins.name: Orbis Patches
plugins.description: Looks up PlayStation 4 title IDs such as CUSA04762 or CUSA-04762 on ORBISPatches and shows the game’s name, art and a link to its patch page.

plugins.name: Prospero Patches
plugins.description: Looks up PlayStation 5 title IDs such as PPSA01628 or PPSA-01628 on PROSPEROPatches and shows the game’s name, art and a link to its patch page.
